description: Use when the user asks about one specific standing offer on the XP marketplace -- whether it filled, how much of it is left, or 'did that offer get my tickets'. Returns the offer at any status along with the fills it has taken, so it answers for filled and rescinded offers that `list_my_standing_bids` does not show. Requires auth.

standing_bid_id.description: Standing offer id from list_my_standing_bids or create_standing_bid.

name: get_standing_bid
title: Standing Offer Detail
